profile_text.body:
Equifax Inc. is a public company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, trading under the ticker EFX, that describes itself as a credit bureau. According to its website, it provides credit reports and credit scores for both businesses and consumers, along with identity protection tools offering daily monitoring and alerts. Its consumer offerings include Equifax Complete, and the company says that customers who become victims of identity theft are assigned dedicated ID Restoration Specialists who work on their behalf toward recovery.

Much of the site is educational. It publishes material on how financial behavior affects credit, what appears on credit reports and why, warning signs of fraud and identity theft, debt and its effect on credit scores, choosing and managing credit cards, personal finance and saving, and the different types of loans, including personal and student loans and the considerations around co-signing. It also offers Spanish-language information covering Equifax credit reports in the United States, credit scores, and money management advice.

The company's profile lists a CIK of 0000033185 and identifies it as a for-profit public company. No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are recorded for it. Its tracked litigation exposure is concentrated in Georgia, with a count of 83.
